questions.question: How many orders are there in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders

questions.question: What is the total revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(total_price),2) AS revenue FROM orders

questions.question: Show revenue by product category
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(oi.quantity*oi.price_at_purchase),2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: Show me the number of orders per month over the last 6 months
questions.reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders) - INTERVAL 6 MONTH GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is the average review rating per category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, round(avg(r.rating),2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: How many payments are completed, pending and failed?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT transaction_status, count(*) AS payments FROM payment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: Which 5 products sold the most units?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, sum(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many delivered shipments does each carrier have?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT carrier, count(*) AS delivered FROM shipments WHERE shipment_status='Delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many distinct customers have placed an order?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM orders

questions.question: What is the total amount of failed payments?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(amount),2) AS failed_amount FROM payment WHERE transaction_status='Failed'
